/create-context.input: Project slug and optional project name/description
/create-context.output: .github/knowledge_context/{slug}/ with KNOWLEDGE_CONTEXT.md and all template files + registry entry

/update-context.input: Project slug and optional --file flag to target a specific context file
/update-context.output: Updated context files for the target project

/check-context.input: Optional project slug (defaults to active_project in registry)
/check-context.output: Context audit report with gap analysis and health score

conditions: User asks to create, update, or check a project context
Knowledge context setup or audit requested
User references deployment_context, architecture context, or project rules
